# PR:225 — `Zigate` → `Domoticz-Zigbee` package_id rename

- Author: pipiche38 (external). Branch `registry/z4d-package-id-domoticz-zigbee`.
- Files: `registry.json`, `.github/package_identity_migration.json`, tests.
- Verdict: **MERGEABLE** (confidence: high).

## Evidence

1. **Repo identity unchanged.** Current `Zigate` record already points at
   `https://github.com/zigbeefordomoticz/Domoticz-Zigbee` (branch `stable9`) with
   no `previous_identities`. The PR only renames `package_id`; repository identity
   stays `github.com/zigbeefordomoticz/domoticz-zigbee`, so no
   `previous_identities` entry is needed.
2. **Post-merge registry validates.** Applied the PR diff to local
   `registry.json`: `RegistryDocument.from_document` OK (293 packages),
   round-trip `to_bytes()` identical, no `Zigate` package remains, new record has
   `domoticz_key: "Zigate"`.
3. **Installed-folder matching survives.** Install target folder is
   `entry.key` == `package_id` (`plugin_core.py:14177`, `_install_locked`
   `plugin_core.py:15447` → `host.resolve_plugin_dir(entry.key)`). Existing
   `plugins/Zigate` folders keep matching via `domoticz_key_lookup` (priority 15,
   `match_domoticz_key_candidate` `plugin_core.py:19835`), git-remote lookup
   (10), and archive/flexible lookups (40) — all unchanged because
   `domoticz_key` and repo URL are unchanged. Only NEW installs land in a
   `Domoticz-Zigbee` folder; no migration gap.
4. **Rename-tolerant identity checks.** `registry_entry_accepts_repository_identity`
   (`plugin_core.py:2121`) accepts current + `previous_identities`;
   `detect_installed_registry_mismatch` (`plugin_core.py:19651`) treats
   `previous_identities` as `renamed_from`. Repo identity unchanged ⇒ no
   `repository_mismatch` for existing installs.
5. **Release-metadata markers.** `inspect_release_install_match`
   (`plugin_core.py:19450`) marks `orphan` only when `metadata.package_id` is
   absent from `plugin_data`. Current `release_index.json` (seq 31) has NO
   descriptor with `package_id: Zigate` (only unrelated `Zigbee2Mqtt`), so no
   installed marker can become orphan.
6. **Migration report file.** `.github/package_identity_migration.json` is a
   report artifact written by `migrate_registry_v2.py --report`
   (`.github/scripts/migrate_registry_v2.py:376`); not consumed at runtime. PR
   edit matches what a re-run produces.

## Post-merge coupling (action required)

- Current `release_index.json` pairs with current registry bytes via
  `registry_sha256` (verified match). After merge, `ReleaseIndex.from_document`
  against the new registry bytes fails: "release index does not match registry
  bytes" (verified locally).
- Runtime effect: `refreshReleaseMetadata` (`plugin_core.py:20129`) catches the
  `accept_remote` ValueError and falls back to `store.load()`
  (`plugin_core.py:3748`), recovering the last trusted generation or the bundled
  pair via `_historical_index` (`plugin_core.py:3425`, validates with
  now=generated_at, no current-time expiry). Release mutations pause
  (`release_authorized=False`, `_unauthorized_selection` `plugin_core.py:3574`)
  until a fresh index pairs with the new registry — safe degradation, no data
  loss.
- Next release-index generation MUST use `package_id: "Domoticz-Zigbee"` with
  `repository_identity: "github.com/zigbeefordomoticz/domoticz-zigbee"` and a
  `registry_sha256` matching the new registry bytes; `bind_release_index.py`
  (`.github/scripts/bind_release_index.py:32`) recomputes the sha and bumps
  `sequence` when the binding changes.

## Risks

- Low. Only behavioral change: new installs target `plugins/Domoticz-Zigbee`.
  Users who installed via Release delivery before the rename keep their folder
  (matched via domoticz_key/repo identity); a fresh Release install after the
  rename would create a new folder only if the old folder is absent.
